findings.title: PasswordField type prop is overridden when props.type is passed
findings.body: In `EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx` (line 176), `<PasswordField type="password" ... />` is rendered. In `PasswordField` (`packages/ui/components/form/inputs/Input.tsx`), `{...props}` is spread after `type={isPasswordVisible ? "text" : "password"}` on `<InputField>`. When `type="password"` is passed by the caller, it overwrites the computed `type` attribute, so clicking the show/hide password eye button in `EnableTwoFactorModal` has no effect and the password stays masked.

findings.title: Third-party (Google/SAML) 2FA login cannot use backup codes and fails if attempted
findings.body: When a user with a third-party identity provider (e.g., Google or SAML) and 2FA enabled logs in, they are redirected to `/auth/login?totp=<jwt>`, which sets `totpEmail`. In `apps/web/pages/auth/login.tsx` (lines 180-182), `ExternalTotpFooter` is rendered instead of `TwoFactorFooter` when `totpEmail` is set, so the "Lost access" button to enter a backup code is never shown. Furthermore, in `packages/features/auth/lib/next-auth-options.ts` (lines 113-119), the third-party IdP checks (`if (user.identityProvider !== IdentityProvider.CAL && !credentials.totpCode)`) only check `!credentials.totpCode` and not `!credentials.backupCode`, so even if a backup code were submitted without a `totpCode`, `authorize` would throw `ThirdPartyIdentityProviderEnabled` instead of verifying the backup code.

findings.title: First E2E test does not close backup codes modal and uses an unawaited promise in expect
findings.body: In `apps/web/playwright/login.2fa.e2e.ts` (lines 52-53), after `fillOtp` completes in the first test (`"should allow a user to enable 2FA and login using 2FA"`), the modal transitions to the new `DisplayBackupCodes` step, which keeps the modal open and blocks `onEnable()` from being called until the user clicks `[data-testid="backup-codes-close"]` (unlike the second test at line 125). The test only passes because `expect(page.locator(...).isChecked()).toBeTruthy()` checks the truthiness of an unawaited `Promise<boolean>` (which is always truthy) instead of `await expect(page.locator(...)).toBeChecked()`, and the subsequent step immediately navigates away with `page.goto("/auth/logout")`.
